disclosures: The binding rules were fixed after a read-only look at the input shapes (key names, id forms, layer names) and before any value was written; FREEZE_V1.md section 5 says so.

Several bound objects are the scoring lane's own identities for prose or manifest lines (e.g. GMI833_V2_LEGACY_001_V0.2 binds a prose line; two B2 rows bind a manifest line and a JSON ledger line). The placement is copied faithfully; the identity is the scoring lane's, not this package's.

The 40 by-name parents copied from #949 include strings lifted verbatim from prose (a section reference, a file path). They are kept out of claim_dependencies and are not claimed to be parents in any stronger sense.
Registered ledger content is copied as extracted by the claim-discipline lane; some EXTRACTED entries are thin (e.g. a table caption line). This package does not grade ledger quality.
